# MCU

Files related to the embedded system part of the project.
It consists of an STM32 project, refer to [`INSTALL.md`](../INSTALL.md)
to install and get information about the required tools.

## What's generated by STM32CubeMX

- In `Core/`
	- Base (hardware-specific functions)
		- `stm32l4xx_it.h`/`.c`
		- `stm32l4xx_hal_conf.h`
		- `stm32l4xx_hal_msp.c`
		- `syscalls.c`
		- `sysmem.c`
		- `system-stm32l4xx.c`
	- Peripherals (enabled in MX)
		- `adc.h`/`.c`
		- `dma.h`/`.c` *(enabled during P2b)*
		- `gpio.h`/`.c`
		- `spi.h`/`.c`
		- `tim.h`/`.c` *(enabled during P2a)*
		- `usart.h`/`.c`
	- Main (application entry point)
		- `main.c`/`.h`
- In `Drivers/`
	- `STM32L4xx_HAL_Driver` Hardware Abstraction layer provided by ST
	- `CMSIS` ARM-specific drivers

> [!TIP]
> None of these files were modified except `main.c`.
> Do not forget to write your code inside `USER CODE` brackets
> otherwise it will be overwritten by MX code generator.

## What we added on top of MX-generated code

- In `Core/`
	- `config.h` Configuration macros
	- `acquisition.h`/`.c` Acquisition of raw audio samples
	- `computation.h`/`.c` and `computation_tables.h` Computation of Mel-vectors
	- `transfer.h`/`.c` Packetisation and data transfer
	- `eval_radio.h`/`.c` For telecom testing purposes
	- `utils.h`/`.c` Utilitary functions
- In `Drivers/`
	- `AES` Software implementation of AES algorithm
	- `S2LP` S2LP radio driver
	- `CMSIS-DSP` ARM-specific optimised math library

> [!TIP]
> We encourage you to read all these files
> to understand the code we provide you.

## UART Reader

A previous student has contributed to the project by writing and sharing a nice graphical UART reader. 
It really simplifies the interactions between the MCU and the host computer.
Thanks again Victor and group E 2024-2025 !

It is located in the `contrib` folder, run it with:

```bash
uv run uart-reader
```

Read the documentation from the [`README in the contrib folder`](../contrib/README.md)
for more information.

If you find bugs or want to improve the tool, do not hesitate to reach out,
we will gladly help you contribute.
